value.rationale: K4,4 is the canonical first complete bipartite graph supporting two disjoint four-cycles; the exact rank-12 integral lattice of 18 geometric tori and its split symmetry under the full 1152-element automorphism group are structural topology absent from mere Betti numbers. The representation distinguishes two different Specht constituents and has no invariants even though 12-dimensional homology exists.
